description: Test vectors for docs/algorithm.md (matched photometry). Barnard field, detector 2, visit A = 0 (earlier) and visit B = 2 (about 6 months later). Generated by validation/scripts/09_algorithm_vectors.py with validation/wp/m2ref.py; all computed numbers are rounded to 4 significant figures. Fluxes are MJy/sr summed over native pixels (IMAGE - ZODI); var is the inflated variance, var_raw before the 2 percent term. lam and bw are micrometres at the star's detector pixel (spectral WCS calibration). Star positions are Gaia DR3 propagated to MJD-AVG with proper motion and parallax. x, y are 0-based cutout pixels. stamp: a 17 x 17 pixel excerpt of the first accepted visit-A exposure (P, V rounded to 6 significant figures, raw FLAGS) with expected photometry for a pixel-level test of steps 1-2.
